reasons: Aggregation differs: the Datadog query sums across series (sum:redis.keys) but the candidate uses avg(), which gives an average per-db key count instead of the total keys.

The candidate drops the $host template variable (prefix host, default *). It should become a host-label matcher of the form label=~"$host"; the candidate applies no host filter at all, so the series set differs.
Quantity and unit match: redis.db.keys is a gauge of keys ({key}) and is the per-db breakdown of redis.keys, so summing across the db attribute yields the same total.
The host label name is not confirmed by dataset_labels (only redis_version is observed), so the exact matcher label needs verification before it is emitted.
Outcome translated is appropriate because an OTel metric measures the same quantity and no function is used.
